name: The Luna
lede: On a custom coastal home built for the Wilmington Parade of Homes, custom recessed Bromic heaters warm the porch above the pool – in a home that took Gold for Best Outdoor Living.
data: Parade of Homes show home – pool porch
Custom recessed Bromic heaters – model to confirm
beats: The Luna is a custom coastal home by Hardison Building, with a gunite pool and hot tub, exotic-wood porch ceilings and an outdoor kitchen.
The porch overlooking the pool had to be as inviting as the rooms inside, with heat that disappears into the timber ceiling.
Custom recessed Bromic heaters are set into the porch ceiling above the pool terrace. The listing records a Gold award for Best Outdoor Living.
